text:
anya: Quick intake check — two open models added to intake: MosaicX-7B and FalconLite-40B. Need: license sign-off, perf profiles (p50/p95 for seq256/512), owner for rollout, and quantization plan. Timeline: want catalog staged by next Wed 2026-03-25. Ping owners. Thanks.

liam: I'll take MosaicX-7B. I've started a perf run. @maria can you confirm GPU availability for canary?

maria: us-west2 has 4 x a100-80gb free weekdays, but not enough for full dedicated. For canary we can do 2 shards. Also need runtime flag `enable_kv_prefetch` for MosaicX.

samir: I'll take FalconLite-40B. License looks odd — model card says 'research only' for some checkpoints. @olivia-legal can you advise?

olivia-legal: Looking... FalconLite-40B upstream has a 'research-only' checkpoint but there is a commercial release under MIT for weights v2. Need exact commit/hash. Samir, please paste the model origin link.

samir: Link: https://models.example/falconlite/40b/commit/abc123 — commit msg shows 'research-only' tag. Uploading copied license snapshot. Also: bench results from local quick run (seq256 batch4): p50 80ms p95 220ms on a100-80. Need optimized kernels for better p95.

bench-bot: bench-bot: Automated microbench — MosaicX-7B seq512 batch8 on a100-80: p50 95ms, p95 315ms, throughput 420 tok/s. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/1781234567/mosaicx-7b

anya: That's helpful. For catalog perf profile we need two shapes: short (seq128) and long (seq1024). Can someone run seq1024 for MosaicX? Also list quantization compatibility (int8/4).

liam: Running seq1024 now, will post shortly. Early note: MosaicX responds well to 4-bit quantization with minor loss. Need eng-runtime to confirm kernel support.

maria: Ops note: quantized builds require cuda 12.3 stack and libcuda-quant patch applied. I've queued infra change, ETA 48h.

olivia-legal: Update: FalconLite v2 (MIT) is OK for commercial use; v1 research-only is not. Samir, point catalog to v2 hash and include license field 'MIT' in metadata.

anya: Ownership: liam owner for MosaicX-7B, samir owner for FalconLite-40B. @maria will coordinate infra for canary. Next milestone: perf profiles uploaded + license OK by 2026-03-24 EOD. If blockers post here. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: bench-bot: seq1024 result for MosaicX-7B p50 420ms p95 980ms throughput 160 tok/s. Artifact: https://ci.redwood/bench/1781234567/mosaicx-7b/seq1024

liam: Got it. Will also add prompt eval set and regression tests to the onboarding PR. PR will be ready for review by end of day tomorrow.

maria: Infra note: canary slot reserved for MosaicX on 2026-03-22 10:00 UTC, tagging liam.

olivia-legal: Final: license metadata approved for both models. I attached short blurb to include in catalog: 'FalconLite-40B (MIT v2) — commercial use permitted. MosaicX-7B (Apache-2.0) — weights verified distributable.'

anya: Perfect. Closing loop: milestones — (1) license OK (olivia) — done, (2) perf profiles (liam+bench-bot) — in progress, (3) infra for quantized runs (maria) — in progress, (4) PR + evals (liam) — due tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
